comparison.objective: Scrape filter cake from a process surface; unlike commissioning and locking a compact shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Likely sustained-angle scraping, contact-force regulation, and material removal, versus recessed hex-key use, fine collar rotation, bimanual counterholding, tightening, and iterative impact evaluation. Body and specs are absent.
comparison.success_condition: Title implies sufficient filter-cake removal without unacceptable substrate damage or spill, but no removal threshold, residue limit, force bound, or rubric is available. Candidate requires specified dynamic-stop behavior and lock retention.
comparison.reason: Surface material removal under controlled contact tests a different mechanism and outcome from tuning a rigid damper assembly.
